labels.label: context
labels.reason: GeoModelAdmin and OSMGeoAdmin are deprecated with replacements named, so they still work and need no action at this release.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The undocumented BaseForm._html_output() is only deprecated, so it still functions and requires no action now.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Returning a str from ErrorList and ErrorDict is merely deprecated, so existing code keeps working for now.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Features that finished their deprecation cycle are removed in 4.0, so applications still using them will break and need changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The urlquote and urlunquote functions in django.utils.http are removed, so any import or call will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: force_text() and smart_text() are removed from django.utils.encoding, which breaks code that imports them.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The ugettext family of translation functions is removed, so code calling them will raise errors.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: set_language() no longer writes the language to request.session, so code relying on that session key will behave differently.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom Expression.get_group_by_cols() subclasses must accept alias=None in their signature, so existing overrides need updating.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.utils.text.unescape_entities() is removed, so callers will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.utils.http.is_safe_url() is removed, so code importing or calling it will break.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: This is only a pointer to the 3.1 deprecation notes and requires no action by itself.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The PASSWORD_RESET_TIMEOUT_DAYS setting is removed, so projects using it must migrate to PASSWORD_RESET_TIMEOUT.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: isnull lookups no longer accept non-boolean values, so queries passing such values will now behave differently or fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The InvalidQuery exception class is removed, so any code importing or catching it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The django-admin.py entry point is removed, so scripts or deployments invoking it must switch to django-admin.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: HttpRequest.is_ajax() is removed, so views and middleware calling it will raise AttributeError.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for pre-3.1 CookieStorage cookie formats is removed, so old message cookies will no longer be read.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Pre-3.1 SHA-1 admin password reset tokens are no longer accepted, so outstanding reset links will stop working.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Pre-3.1 session encoding support is removed, so existing sessions in that format will be invalidated or fail to decode.
